rows.definition: The canonical leaf spelling of the DS4.1 folded Engram gate coefficient tensor (engram_folded_gate.weight): one F32 resident weight carrying the pre-composed per-cell gate product that the V4.1 forward consumes directly, which the GGUF and SafeTensors loaders resolve the locally evidenced upstream spelling onto so the forward's admission lookup finds it.
rows.distinction: A model-weight tensor name and loader alias target, not an authorization guard or safety policy gate; not the CUDA device-side Engram gating kernel (cudaV41EngramGate); not the unfolded q/k norm leaves (engram_q_norm / engram_k_norm) whose product it replaces; and not the look-ahead read-policy or serial-selection knobs that gate Engram serving rather than its coefficients.
